##### ABOUT

# Who is Affordable Insulation?

Experts in home insulation solutions, helping families save on energy bills, boost comfort, and increase home value with quality and sustainability.
With an experienced team and high-grade materials, Affordable Insulation delivers personalized services focused on energy efficiency, lasting performance, and year-round comfort. Our mission is to turn your space into a more comfortable, safer, and cost-effective home — all year long.
Thermal Barrier Fire Paint: Adds crucial fire resistance when used with spray foam, enhancing safety and building code compliance.
Fiberglass: A proven choice made from fine glass fibers, it’s effective at reducing heat transfer and works in various applications.
Rockwool (Mineral Wool): Fire- and sound-resistant, made from natural stone — great for safety, sustainability, and thermal control.
Blow-In Cellulose: Eco-friendly loose-fill insulation made from recycled paper that fits tight spaces and provides full coverage.
Closed Cell Insulation: High-performance spray foam offering top-tier energy efficiency and moisture control — ideal for any property.
Open Cell Insulation: Flexible and budget-friendly, this spray foam expands to seal air leaks and offers great soundproofing for interiors.
At Affordable Insulation, we believe comfort, savings, and sustainability go hand in hand — and we’re here to prove it.
